The FTC notice draft proceeds with actual notification of 550 consumers, treating the FTC obligation as applicable despite the 4800 maintenance total.

criteria.name: LAW005

The xlsx ExposureLedger explicitly notes '加密，但密钥被攻击者取得' and '是：§314.2(m)视为未加密' for the relevant records; the memo states '加密文件与密钥均被攻击者取得，依§314.2(m)视为未加密'; and the FTC draft explains '信息位于一个加密导出文件中；攻击者同时取得该文件的解密密钥。因此，依16 CFR §314.2(m)，该客户信息为本通知定义下的未加密信息'. Facts and definitions accurately correspond across all three files.
